detail: Dachepalli Publishers Ltd (544667) - Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A of Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we would like to inform you that the meeting of the Board of Directors (the 'Board') of the Company held on Tuesday, 24th November, 2026, commenced at 11:00 AM and concluded at 12.00 P.M. has the Board took note of the successful completion of the acquisition. Accordingly, Hara Communications Private Limited has become a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company. The Board also approved the necessary disclosures and statutory filings with BSE Limited and other applicable authorities.
